---
title: "camden yards economic impact"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
econ_impact <- read_csv("camdenyardseconomics.csv")
```

```{r}
econ_impact |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = `Direct Spending`)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Direct Spending at Camden Yards Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Direct Spending (in millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
